snippet.title: Pourquoi les avions de chasse gardent un canon alors qu'on se bat au missile à plus de 100 km ?
snippet.description:
Pourquoi les avions de chasse gardent un canon alors qu'on se bat au missile à plus de 100 km ? 

En combat aérien, le canon ne sert presque plus, et il n'a souvent que quelques secondes de munitions. Pourtant, les Américains ont accepté d'accrocher un pod canon sous le ventre du F 35 B, quitte à le rendre moins discret. Quand les missiles sont partis, c'est la dernière chance du pilote. Et face aux drones Shahed, qui coûtent des dizaines de milliers de dollars contre plus d'un million pour un missile, le canon redevient l'arme la plus rentable. En Ukraine, des F 16 et des MiG 29 abattent déjà des drones au canon.

Images réelles : US Navy / F 35 Joint Program Office (essais du canon GAU 22, NAS Patuxent River).
Animations 2D et 3D : ALD. Modèle 3D F 35 : Sketchfab (CC BY 4.0).

snippet.title: 니트 세탁방법, 세탁망 속에서도 옷은 상합니다
snippet.description:
세탁망까지 챙겨 넣었는데
니트가 쭈글쭈글 줄어들어
비싸게 산 옷을 망쳐 속상하시죠?
정답은 👇👇

어느 지역에서 보고 계신지 댓글로 공유해 주세요❤️

세탁망에 넣었으니 괜찮겠지 하고 빨았는데 크기와 모양이 달라지면 속상하죠. 깨끗하게 입으려고 세탁했는데 옷감까지 뻣뻣해지면 다시 손이 가지 않습니다. 니트는 세제뿐 아니라 비비고 헹구고 말리는 과정까지 함께 신경 써야 합니다.
이럴 때는 헹굼이 필요 없는 노린스 울세제를 활용해 보세요. 물세탁이 허용된 니트를 대상으로, 제품에 ‘헹굼 불필요’라고 표시된 전용 세제를 사용하는 방법입니다.
대야에 미지근한 물을 받고 세제를 제품에 표시된 양만큼 풀어주세요. 니트를 넣고 전체가 충분히 젖도록 가볍게 눌러줍니다. 비비거나 주무르지 말고 약 십오 분 담가주세요. 담금 시간은 사용하는 세제의 안내를 우선해 주세요.
담근 뒤에는 헹구지 않고 대야의 물을 빼주세요. 니트를 가볍게 눌러 물기를 덜어내고, 젖은 옷이 길게 늘어지지 않도록 밑을 받쳐 꺼내줍니다.
깨끗한 수건 위에 니트를 펼치고 수건과 함께 돌돌 말아 지그시 눌러주세요. 비틀어 짜는 대신 수건이 물기를 흡수하게 하는 과정입니다.
마지막으로 마른 수건이나 평평한 건조대에 펼쳐주세요. 어깨와 소매, 밑단을 원래 모양으로 정리하고 통풍이 잘되는 그늘에서 충분히 말려줍니다.
핵심은 비비고 헹구는 마찰을 줄이고, 젖은 니트가 늘어지지 않게 말리는 것입니다. 아끼는 니트의 부드러운 결과 깔끔한 옷태를 함께 챙겨보세요.

영상 속 니트 이미지를 누르시면 비밀 재료가 ￼자세히 나오니 꼭 확인해 보세요

오늘도 시청해 주셔서 감사합니다🙇
❤️ 좋아요는 영상 제작에 큰 힘이 됩니다.
💬 여러분은 니트를 어떻게 세탁하시나요?
댓글로 공유해 주세요.

snippet.title: 구마 겐고가 땅에 몸을 낮춰 지은 제주의 돌집
snippet.description:
🎬 데뷔작이 야유받고 도쿄에서 10년 밀려난 건축가가 국립경기장을 짓기까지 — 구마 겐고 이야기는 채널 롱폼에서

2008년, 롯데는 제주 한라산 중턱에 별장 단지를 구상하며 건축가 다섯 명에게 한 구역씩 맡겼습니다. 그중 한 명인 일본 건축가 구마 겐고는 처음 와 본 제주에서 구멍이 숭숭 뚫린 검은 화산석에 반해, 집 한 채 한 채를 둥근 돌멩이처럼 설계했습니다. 건물이 솟아올라 주변을 누르기보다 자연에 몸을 낮춰야 한다는 그의 생각을, 제주의 낮은 오름이 더 굳혀 줬다고 전해집니다.

롯데리조트 제주 아트빌라스 D블록 「제주 볼」(2012)은 반쯤 땅에 묻힌 돌집 14채로, 살짝 휜 콘크리트 판 위에 화산석을 한 겹 깔고 처마 끝만은 철망 위에 돌을 얹어 돌 틈으로 빛이 들게 했습니다. 자연 앞에 몸을 낮춘 집은 단지에서 가장 인기 있는, 값비싼 별장이 됐습니다.

· 비즈니스포스트 — 롯데그룹과 일본 건축가 켄고 쿠마의 '오래된 인연', 작은 오해에도 협업 지속 (2023)

snippet.title: #tweening
snippet.description:
Islam is one of the world’s major religions, followed by over a billion people across many countries. It began in the 7th century in the city of Mecca with the teachings of the Prophet Muhammad. Muslims believe that he received revelations from God (Allah), which were later compiled into the holy book called the Qur'an.

Core Beliefs

Islam is strictly monotheistic, meaning Muslims believe in only one God, called Allah. The central concept is submission to the will of God, which is what the word “Islam” means.

Muslims follow six main beliefs:

Belief in one God (Allah)

Belief in angels

Belief in holy books (including the Qur'an, Torah, Psalms, and Gospel in their original forms)

Belief in prophets (such as Adam, Moses, and Jesus, with Muhammad as the final prophet)

Belief in the Day of Judgment

Belief in divine destiny (Qadar)


The Five Pillars of Islam

These are the main acts of worship that guide a Muslim’s daily life:

1. Shahada – Declaration of faith


2. Salat – Praying five times a day


3. Zakat – Giving charity to those in need


4. Sawm – Fasting during the holy month of Ramadan


5. Hajj – Pilgrimage to Mecca at least once if able



Holy Places

Kaaba – The most sacred site in Islam

Al-Masjid an-Nabawi – Mosque of the Prophet in Medina

Al-Aqsa Mosque – One of the oldest and most important mosques


Practices and Lifestyle

Islam provides guidance for daily life, including:

Halal and Haram (permitted and forbidden actions)

Modesty in behavior and dress

Respect for parents and elders

Honesty, charity, and kindness


Branches of Islam

The two main branches are:

Sunni Islam – The largest group

Shia Islam – The second largest group


Holy Days and Celebrations

Eid al-Fitr – Celebrates the end of Ramadan

Eid al-Adha – Commemorates the willingness of Prophet Abraham to sacrifice his son


Summary

Islam is a complete way of life that emphasizes faith in one God, moral conduct, compassion, justice, and community. Its teachings influence not only religious practices but also social, ethical, and personal behavior.

snippet.title: My Chef Husband Told the Staff He'd Say YES to Everything!
snippet.description:
Give this man a menu and a staff willing to feed him, and things are going to get out of hand. 

We stopped by Two Guys Brewing in Wyoming, Michigan, to try one of every appetizer. But Jason decided to introduce a new rule: whenever someone asked if he’d like to try something, he basically had to say yes. (I’m afraid of this rule sticking 🥴)

Which is how we ended up with a Monte Cristo, a coney burger, and bread pudding on top of everything else. 

But beyond the food, we loved getting to hear about the heart behind this place and the ways they’re giving back to their community. Good food and good people doing good things. That’s the kind of place we love supporting.

What should we try next time? Drop your favorite local spot!

snippet.title: Chicken Tikka Masala | Recipe ⬇️
snippet.description:
Servings: 4–6
Prep Time: 20 minutes, plus marinating time
Cook Time: 45–55 minutes

Ingredients

Chicken Marinade

2 lb boneless, skinless chicken thighs, cut into bite-sized pieces

⅔ cup full-fat plain yogurt

1 tablespoon + 1 teaspoon lemon juice

1⅓ teaspoons turmeric powder

2 teaspoons homemade garam masala blend (recipe below)

⅔ teaspoon chili powder or cayenne pepper

1⅓ teaspoons ground cumin

1 tablespoon + 1 teaspoon freshly grated ginger

3 cloves garlic, crushed

Homemade Garam Masala Blend

2 tablespoons ground coriander

2 teaspoons ground cumin

2 teaspoons ground cardamom

2 teaspoons ground cinnamon

1 teaspoon ground cloves

1 teaspoon ground black pepper

2 teaspoons ground nutmeg

Combine all spices thoroughly. Measure out 2 teaspoons for the marinade. Store the remaining blend in an airtight container.

Curry Sauce

1½ tablespoons TALO beef tallow

1½ tablespoons ghee

½ medium yellow onion, finely diced (or 1 small onion)

2 tablespoons + 2 teaspoons tomato paste

1 cup + ¼ cup tomato sauce

1⅓ cups heavy cream

1 tablespoon + 1 teaspoon sugar

1¾ teaspoons salt, to start

2–4 tablespoons water, as needed

To Serve

Basmati rice or white rice

Fresh cilantro, chopped (optional)

Instructions

1. Prepare the Garam Masala

Combine all the spices in a small bowl and mix thoroughly. Measure out 2 teaspoons for the marinade.

2. Marinate the Chicken

In a large bowl, combine the yogurt, lemon juice, turmeric, garam masala, chili powder, cumin, ginger, and garlic.

Add the chicken and mix until every piece is thoroughly coated.

Cover and refrigerate for at least 3 hours, preferably overnight, and up to 24 hours.

3. Sauté the Onions

In a large, heavy-bottomed pot or Dutch oven, heat the TALO beef tallow and ghee over medium heat.

Add the diced onion and cook for 5–8 minutes, stirring occasionally, until softened and beginning to turn golden.

4. Cook the Tomato Paste

Add the tomato paste and stir to combine.

Cook for 2–3 minutes, stirring frequently, until the paste darkens slightly and develops a deeper aroma.

5. Add the Tomato Sauce

Pour in the tomato sauce and stir thoroughly, scraping the bottom of the pot to incorporate the flavorful bits from the onions and tomato paste.

Bring to a gentle simmer and cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.

6. Add the Chicken and Marinade

Reduce the heat to medium-low.

Add all the marinated chicken directly to the pot, including the yogurt marinade. Stir thoroughly to distribute the chicken throughout the sauce.

Allow the mixture to return to a gentle simmer, stirring frequently to prevent sticking.

Once simmering, cook for approximately 15–20 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the chicken is nearly cooked through.

7. Add the Cream and Seasonings

Reduce the heat to low.

Slowly stir in the heavy cream, sugar, and salt.

Add 2 tablespoons of water to start if needed. Continue simmering gently for another 10–15 minutes, stirring occasionally.

Avoid boiling the sauce vigorously, as this can cause the dairy to separate.

8. Check and Adjust

Check the internal temperature of several chicken pieces. The chicken must reach at least 165°F.

Taste the sauce and adjust the salt as needed.

If the sauce is too thick, gradually add more water. If it’s too thin, continue simmering uncovered over low heat until it reaches your preferred consistency.

9. Serve

Garnish with freshly chopped cilantro if desired.

Serve hot over basmati rice or white rice.

1 tablespoon + 1 teaspoon lemon juice

1⅓ teaspoons turmeric powder

2 teaspoons homemade garam masala blend (recipe below)

⅔ teaspoon chili powder or cayenne pepper

1⅓ teaspoons ground cumin

1 tablespoon + 1 teaspoon freshly grated ginger

3 cloves garlic, crushed

Homemade Garam Masala Blend

2 tablespoons ground coriander

2 teaspoons ground cumin

2 teaspoons ground cardamom

2 teaspoons ground cinnamon

1 teaspoon ground cloves

1 teaspoon ground black pepper

2 teaspoons ground nutmeg

Combine all spices thoroughly. Measure out 2 teaspoons for the marinade. Store the remaining blend in an airtight container.

Curry Sauce

1½ tablespoons TALO beef tallow

1½ tablespoons ghee

½ medium yellow onion, finely diced (or 1 small onion)

2 tablespoons + 2 teaspoons tomato paste

1 cup + ¼ cup tomato sauce

1⅓ cups heavy cream

1 tablespoon + 1 teaspoon sugar

1¾ teaspoons salt, to start

2–4 tablespoons water, as needed

To Serve

Basmati rice or white rice

Fresh cilantro, chopped (optional)

Instructions

1. Prepare the Garam Masala

Combine all the spices in a small bowl and mix thoroughly. Measure out 2 teaspoons for the marinade.

2. Marinate the Chicken

In a large bowl, combine the yogurt, lemon juice, turmeric, garam masala, chili powder, cumin, ginger, and garlic.

Add the chicken and mix until every piece is thoroughly coated.

Cover and refrigerate for at least 3 hours, preferably overnight, and up to 24 hours.

3. Sauté the Onions

In a large, heavy-bottomed pot or Dutch oven, heat the TALO beef tallow and ghee over medium heat.

Add the diced onion and cook for 5–8 minutes, stirring occasionally, until softened and beginning to turn golden.

4. Cook the Tomato Paste

Add the tomato paste and stir to combine.

Cook for 2–3 minutes, stirring frequently, until the paste darkens slightly and develops a deeper aroma.

5. Add the Tomato Sauce

Pour in the tomato sauce and stir thoroughly, scraping the bottom of the pot to incorporate the flavorful bits from the onions and tomato paste.

Bring to a gentle simmer and cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.

6. Add the Chicken and Marinade

Reduce the heat to medium-low.

Add all the marinated chicken directly to the pot, including the yogurt marinade. Stir thoroughly to distribute the chicken throughout the sauce.

Allow the mixture to return to a gentle simmer, stirring frequently to prevent sticking.

Once simmering, cook for approximately 15–20 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the chicken is nearly cooked through.

7. Add the Cream and Seasonings

Reduce the heat to low.

Slowly stir in the heavy cream, sugar, and salt.

Add 2 tablespoons of water to start if needed. Continue simmering gently for another 10–15 minutes, stirring occasionally.

Avoid boiling the sauce vigorously, as this can cause the dairy to separate.

8. Check and Adjust

Check the internal temperature of several chicken pieces. The chicken must reach at least 165°F.

Taste the sauce and adjust the salt as needed.

If the sauce is too thick, gradually add more water. If it’s too thin, continue simmering uncovered over low heat until it reaches your preferred consistency.

9. Serve

Garnish with freshly chopped cilantro if desired.

Serve hot over basmati rice or white rice.
